fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: MERCHANT TERMINAL ID
fields.description: Unique number assigned to lndividual deposit contracts

fields.name: MERCHANT/AGENT TYPE
fields.description: Unique identifier for the merchant/Agent. Terminal ID

fields.name: AGENT/MERCHANT OPENED DDATE
fields.description: The Merchants/Agents business segment. e.g. Corporate, Small Medium Enterprises (SMEs), Micro Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and Personal.

fields.name: PHYSICAL LOCATION OF AGENT/MERCHANT (SUB-COUNTY CODE)
fields.description: Date when the merchant/agent was opened. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY}.

fields.name: GPS COORDINATE: LATITUDE
fields.description: Sub-County and County where the merchant is located.

fields.name: GPS COORDINATE: LONGITUDE
fields.description: GPS cordinates based on ISO 6709 standards representation of geographic point location by coordinates (Decimal degrees).

fields.name: EMAIL ID OF AGENT/MERCHANT
fields.description: GPS cordinates based on ISO 6709 standards representation of geographic point location by coordinates (Decimal degrees).
